result.topic_en: The outer address sheet of a letter to Professor Dr. Riemann, with marginal calculations on second partial derivatives and on systems of variables a_i, b_i and α_i, β_i, γ_i satisfying sum relations.
result.transcription:
Herrn Professor Dr. Riemann
Wohlgeb.[?]
Hier.

[margin calculations:]
$\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial \dots}\left(\frac{\partial f}{\partial \dots}\frac{\partial f}{\partial \dots} - \frac{\partial f}{\partial \dots}\frac{\partial f}{\partial \dots}\right)$[?]
$\frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial \dots}\frac{\partial f}{\partial \dots} + \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial \dots}\frac{\partial f}{\partial \dots} + \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial \dots}\frac{\partial f}{\partial \dots} + \frac{\partial^2 f}{\partial \dots}\frac{\partial f}{\partial \dots}$[?]
$v_1 - a_1 \quad v_1 - b_1 \quad p=2 \quad 1$[?]
$v_2 - a_2 \quad v_2 - b_2$
$a_1 + \alpha_1 = b_1 + \beta_1$
$a_2 + \alpha_2 = b_2 + \beta_2$
$v_1 - a_1 \quad v_1 - b_1 \quad v_1 - c_1$
$v_2 - a_2 \quad v_2 - b_2 \quad v_2 - c_2$
$v_3 - a_3 \quad v_3 - b_3 \quad v_3 - c_3$
$a_1 + \alpha_1' + \alpha_1'' = b_1 + \beta_1' + \beta_1'' = c_1 + \gamma_1' + \gamma_1''$[?]

methods.what: Relations between shifted variable systems (sums of parameters equal), for p=2
Analogous three-term relation for three systems of variables
